scope: Existing-evidence audit; findings apply to both manuscript versions. No runtime/data/model changes or independent expert judgments.

findings.finding: 48,693 archived records contain 138 exact cross-partition groups affecting 276 images.
findings.correction: Historical scores are not independent held-out performance. No leakage effect size inferred.
findings.remaining: Untouched permitted evaluation data and a separately approved frozen protocol.

findings.finding: 65 zero-area flags; 45 zero-width, 20 zero-height; 47 images have no accepted instances. All 65 originals visually inspected with AI assistance.
findings.correction: Numerical and visual inspection is distinguished from qualified annotation approval and valid negative-image evidence.
findings.remaining: Qualified semantic annotation review; originals unchanged.

findings.finding: 104 identical-pixel groups have numerically different labels: 69 box differences with the same class multiset, 35 class/instance-multiset differences; none only formatting/order. Extra edge flags affect 3,794 rows in 3,346 images.
findings.correction: Report direct numeric disagreements and broader pending geometry review; do not automatically reject every edge flag.
findings.remaining: Adjudicate geometry, incomplete annotations, class meaning and representative selection.

findings.finding: Grouping identities reproduced. Minimum class-specific candidate-group counts are 43/9/11. A 2,020-record perceptual sample yields 16 unreviewed candidates; transform probes reveal major blind spots.
findings.correction: Candidate assignment is not an approved independent benchmark; image support is not independent-family support.
findings.remaining: Human lineage/permission review, including suspicious merges and transformed candidates.

findings.finding: 100 CSV epochs reconstruct exactly from 55+45 rows. Resumed timing resets. Historical notebook outputs are extractable but lack evaluation-time checkpoint hashes and matching final raw predictions.
findings.correction: Keep historical metrics in a qualified appendix; distinguish logged stage time, legacy 30-class notebook, older predictions and current CPU runtime settings.
findings.remaining: Cannot retroactively establish checkpoint identity or independent accuracy. No AP recomputation performed.

findings.finding: 1,014 workbook rows minus nine normalized duplicates plus five supplemental records reconcile to 1,010 rows; 4,040 nutrient fields agree at tolerance 1e-9.
findings.correction: Report transcription consistency separately from recipe equivalence. Distinguish directly accessed and cached primary pages.
findings.remaining: Source permissions and independent recipe/nutrient suitability review.

findings.finding: 30 method/label combinations change row selection across eight hash seeds over 181 labels in two lookup modes; six canonical labels change only without precomputed mappings. Current canonical outputs remain stable.
findings.correction: Disclose alias fallback order sensitivity; do not claim a measured wrong-match rate or silently change compatibility.
findings.remaining: Separately approve deterministic fallback hardening and review its changed outputs.

findings.finding: 19/72, 55/72 and 72/72 quantify lookup availability, not mapping correctness.
findings.correction: Prepare blank blinded all-72 version-2 review/adjudication packet with accepted, unsupported and indeterminate states.
findings.remaining: Real qualified independent judgments; none supplied by the assistant.

findings.finding: 2,880 frontend portion cases and 162,036 goal cases per backend/frontend implementation pass independent rational oracles at declared tolerances.
findings.correction: Separate arithmetic agreement from nutritional prescriptions. Explain backend 1-5,000 versus browser 500-5,000 calorie bounds.
findings.remaining: Clinical basis of existing policy is not validated; boundaries preserved.

findings.finding: 216 offline advice scenarios, 16 real SDK mocked-transport cases and all 36 browser goal/context combinations pass. Stale advice handling, unknown totals and journal regressions pass.
findings.correction: Context badges mean matching backend context, not expert-approved advice. Disclose absent grams, targets and journal inputs.
findings.remaining: Scenario coverage is finite; browser tests do not establish usability or health outcomes.

findings.finding: Fallback templates can imply consumption or suitability; context templates can ignore goal changes and nutrient values. Wording triage is not medical assessment.
findings.correction: Keep medical-quality claims out of both manuscripts; prepare a qualified-review rubric.
findings.remaining: Qualified advice/health-policy assessment; any live pilot requires separate approval.

findings.finding: Old local four-case parity and aggregate timing/memory receipts lack current preview identity and execution provenance.
findings.correction: Do not equate source configuration or 6.38-second local aggregate with current Vercel cold HTTP performance, bundle size or memory acceptance.
findings.remaining: Approved identified preview measurements; no live calls or release performed.

findings.finding: 22 focused bibliography entries checked against primary evidence, including access failures and a recent FKG validation preprint.
findings.correction: Acknowledge prior integrated work; label preprint status; avoid unmatched metric comparisons and systematic-review claims.
findings.remaining: Literature search is bounded, not exhaustive novelty or plagiarism certification.

findings.finding: Author confirmation, asset reuse rights, disclosures, venue suitability and applicable institutional requirements cannot be inferred from repository files.
findings.correction: Preserve explicit pending author/rights/ethics decisions in both drafts.
findings.remaining: Supervisor and relevant rights holders/institution must decide; no approval fabricated.

findings.finding: Two initial extended-browser harness runs failed: ambiguous selector and incorrect mocked route prefix; corrected attempts 3 and strengthened 4 passed.
findings.correction: Preserve failed receipts instead of hiding them; distinguish harness defects from production failures.
findings.remaining: No production fix claimed; final CI mode rerun through the shared browser runner.
